executive_pulse: CISA added OSGeo GeoServer and Drupal Core vulnerabilities to the KEV catalog following active exploitation reports. Supply chain and AI detection tools continue to see active updates.

items.headline: CISA Adds OSGeo GeoServer Flaws to KEV Catalog Following In-the-Wild Exploitation
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-120705 (XML injection/SSRF via GetFeatureById) and CVE-2026-129243 (authorization bypass via prefixed service parameters) to KEV. The flaws can be chained with additional vulnerabilities to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.action: Prioritize patching OSGeo GeoServer installations or restricting public interface access in accordance with CISA BOD 26-04.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event

items.headline: CISA KEV Addition: Unauthenticated Site Takeover in Incomplete Drupal Installations
items.summary: CVE-2026-136716 permits unauthenticated remote attackers to take over sites exposed during unusual or incomplete installation states due to improper condition checks in Drupal Core.
items.action: Ensure Drupal installations are complete and remove exposed installer files or restrict access to setup paths.
items.hunt: Web server logs: unauthenticated HTTP requests targeting the Drupal installer endpoints (e.g., core/install.php).

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: ToolJet Release Workflow Pull Request Title Command Injection
items.summary: ToolJet GitHub Actions release workflow directly interpolates PR titles into shell run blocks. Merging a crafted PR title allows command execution using a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN.
items.action: Update ToolJet to version 3.21.96-LTS or later and audit GitHub Actions workflows for untrusted script evaluations.
items.hunt: GitHub Audit Logs: workflow run triggers on release branches associated with pull requests containing shell metacharacters in titles.

compensating_controls: Remove internet exposure of the affected interface until patched
Apply WAF or IPS signatures from your vendor for the CVE, in blocking mode
Run the service as a non-privileged user and restrict outbound connections
remediation.verify: Hunt for shells or scripting engines spawned by the affected service, and new scheduled tasks or cron entries

items.headline: ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections: Detection Content for AI Agent Attack Frameworks
items.summary: Repository providing detection rules (KQL, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, YARA, Splunk) and IOCs for evaluating and detecting AI agent attack frameworks such as ARTEX and Agent Zero.
items.action: Evaluate provided KQL, Splunk, and Sigma detection rules for inclusion in SIEM/XDR detections monitoring AI agent activity.

items.headline: Root0ne/gguf-radar: Static Analysis and Malware Scanner for GGUF Files
items.summary: Tool for inspecting LLM model files (GGUF format) for hidden malware and poisoned chat templates without execution, aiding in supply chain security for AI deployments.
items.action: Review the scanner for deployment into automated AI/ML model ingestion pipelines to validate third-party GGUF artifacts.
